November 8, 2026


One student arrived at McArthur River expecting to learn about mining. Instead, they discovered just how many opportunities exist within it. Over 12 months, they gained experience in mine planning, ventilation, ground control, field work, data technologies and more. Their biggest takeaway? Stay curious and ask questions. That's often where the best opportunities begin. Where could a work term at Cameco take you?
